title: Director of Medical Group Operations
text:
Director of Medical Group Operations| Medical Practice Leadership

Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group| Aurora, Illinois

Full-Time | Exempt | Days 
Starting Annual Salary: $101,212.80 – $146,619.20

Lead Practice Excellence. Empower Providers. Advance Patient Access.

Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group, a member of Prime Healthcare, is seeking an experienced and collaborative Director of Medical Group Operations to lead the operational performance, growth, and success of physician practices and ambulatory clinics throughout the Aurora market.

This is an outstanding opportunity for a healthcare operations leader who enjoys partnering with physicians, practice leaders, and executive leadership to strengthen practice performance, improve patient access, optimize workflows, and advance strategic growth across a multi-specialty medical group.

We are looking for someone who can think strategically, lead confidently, and drive operational excellence while supporting providers in delivering exceptional, patient-centered care throughout the community.

About Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group

Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group brings together primary care and specialty providers across Illinois, with medical group locations affiliated with Prime Healthcare's Illinois hospitals, including Mercy Medical Center in Aurora.

Our physicians, advanced practice providers, practice leaders, and support teams work collaboratively to provide accessible, coordinated, high-quality care while creating an exceptional patient experience.

As part of Prime Healthcare, Illinois Medical Group benefits from the resources, support, and stability of a nationally recognized health system while maintaining a strong commitment to the healthcare needs of the communities it serves.

Responsibilities:

As Director of Medical Group Operations, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for physician practices and ambulatory services while supporting growth, operational efficiency, provider engagement, and exceptional patient experiences.

* Lead day-to-day operations of physician practices and medical group clinics to ensure high-quality patient care and operational excellence.
* Partner with physicians, practice managers, and executive leadership to develop strategies that support growth, patient access, and performance improvement.
* Oversee staffing, budgeting, productivity, scheduling, and resource allocation across multiple practice locations.
* Monitor operational, financial, quality, and patient experience metrics while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, accreditation standards, and professional practice guidelines.
* Drive initiatives focused on patient access, provider satisfaction, workflow optimization, revenue enhancement, and service-line development.
* Develop, mentor, and support practice leaders and staff while creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and exceptional service.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in business or healthcare management is preferred.
* Master’s degree in business or healthcare management preferred.
* Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in medical practice management required (with direct experience managing the revenue cycle).
* Knowledge of Accounts Receivable management, coding, Medicare & Medicaid regulations, payor contracting, and Billing & Collections.
* Knowledge of credentialing, regulatory compliance, etc.
* Frequent local travel time required.

The Leader Who Will Thrive Here

You are a collaborative, results-driven healthcare leader who is passionate about medical practice operations, provider engagement, and patient access. You thrive in a fast-paced, multi-site environment where relationship-building, operational excellence, and strategic leadership are essential.

You understand that successful medical group leadership goes beyond managing day-to-day operations. It requires vision, accountability, and the ability to bring physicians, practice leaders, and staff together around shared goals that improve access, efficiency, patient satisfaction, and overall performance.

You are a self-starter and hands-on leader who communicates openly, follows through, takes accountability, and is comfortable stepping in to solve operational challenges. You enjoy developing teams, improving workflows, and partnering closely with providers and executive leadership to strengthen medical group performance. These qualities align with the leadership profile established for the Aurora opening.

Why Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group?

At Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group, you'll have the opportunity to lead and develop a network of physician practices while partnering closely with providers, practice leaders, and healthcare executives to strengthen outpatient operations and improve the patient experience.

You'll have the opportunity to improve patient access, strengthen revenue cycle and operational performance, support provider success, develop practice leaders, and help drive the continued growth of a multi-specialty medical group.

Prime Healthcare's Illinois Medical Group network serves communities through medical groups affiliated with hospitals across the state, including Mercy Medical Center, Resurrection Medical Center, Saint Francis Hospital, Saint Joseph Hospital, Saint Joseph Medical Center, Saint Mary of Nazareth Hospital, St. Mary’s Hospital, and Olympia Fields Hospital. As part of Prime Healthcare, the Medical Group benefits from the resources of Prime Healthcare, stability, and opportunities of a nationally recognized, award-winning health system.

If you're ready to bring your medical group leadership experience to an organization where you can make a measurable impact on practice performance, provider engagement, patient access, and patient care, we encourage you to apply.

Pay Transparency:

Prime Healthcare Illinois Medical Group offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package that provides employees the flexibility to tailor benefits according to their individual needs. Our Total Rewards package includes, but is not limited to, paid time off, a 401K retirement plan, medical, dental, and vision coverage, tuition reimbursement, and many more voluntary benefit options. A reasonable compensation estimate for this role, which includes estimated wages, benefits, and other forms of compensation, is $101,212.80 to $146,619.20 on an annualized basis. The exact starting compensation to be offered will be determined at the time of selecting an applicant for hire, in which a wide range of factors will be considered, including but not limited to, skillset, years of applicable experience, education, credentials and licensure.

The company is dedicated to empowering its staff with a comprehensive, competitive benefits package, allowing them the freedom to customize their benefits to fit their unique needs. Our abundant resources, programs, and voluntary options serve as a foundation for individual growth and well-being. Learn more here: https://www.primehealthcare.com/benefitsthatmattermost/

Company is an equal employment opportunity employer. Company prohibits discrimination against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (subject to applicable law), disability, military status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.
